primary_sources: ARCHITECTURE.md section 5.3 and spikes/photon/test.py (existing round-trip evidence)

measured_checks.same_agent_test: Real ConversationAgent with injected native session; web-to-Photon-to-web preserves exact same lease/history; new guest resets same configured thread.
measured_checks.preflight_authority_test: Suspended assignment GET followed by host reset or linked-guest revoke creates no new lease, credential or allocation.
measured_checks.replay_test: SQLite message-ID claim committed before native queue/model; duplicate, reconnect/restart, cancellation and UNKNOWN do not replay.
measured_checks.cleanup_test: Known owned assignments released on revoke/expiry/reset/restart; pre-existing assignments preserved; unknown ownership remains unconfirmed.
measured_checks.audio_test: Same internal CompletedReply receipt passed to speech hook only after Photon 202 acceptance and current authority check.
measured_checks.privacy_test: No message bodies or raw guest phone handles in private SQLite; no handles, message bodies or API keys in public/private event log.

defects_found_and_fixed: Unknown allocation ownership cannot be inferred from matching handle/time.
Invitation or exact linked lease may change while awaiting assignment preflight.
Failed worker or broken store must not prevent both tasks and HTTP/DB resources closing.

deployment.opt_in: TENANT_PHOTON_ENABLED=1 (default off, even when credentials exist)
requires: Existing PHOTON_PROJECT_ID and PHOTON_API_KEY in private local environment
deployment.existing_guest_phone_link: POST /join {room_code,phone,guest_id} plus exact existing cookie or guest_token; expiry and credential unchanged.
deployment.first_text: Actual verified human inbound from assigned handle to assigned line in exact direct space; the entire text reaches core.agent.turn.
deployment.cross_channel_physical_test: Use the Chat here fallback attached to the SAME phone enrollment response; a fresh join intentionally creates a new lease/context.

root_rollout.physical_question: Pending fresh phone Text the room -> dictated Hello Tenant -> iMessage reply plus audible Mac response, superseding prior voice-only question.

limits: One project-wide 2-second poll loop; one worker; at most eight claimed queued requests; busy inputs are marked dropped and never replayed.
At most five pages per polling pass; continuation preserves exact query; empty pages with nextPageToken are followed.
Received text older than enrollment/process start or more than 60 seconds old is ignored.
202 means accepted for asynchronous delivery, not received by the phone.
Assignment release is best effort and cannot roll back effects or unsend an already submitted message.
Unknown allocation acceptance/ownership requires host/provider reconciliation; no allocation retry or guessed seat release.
The native app visually rendering the stored conversation remains a separate acceptance check.
remaining_physical_tests: Fresh phone Text the room enrollment, real inbound natural message, source-correlated same native thread reply, actual iMessage receipt and audible room response.
Same enrollment fallback web chat remembers a fact provided over Photon, with no new guest/reset.
Permission expiry/revoke/reset: no subsequent native turn, reply or speech from stale phone; known owned assignment released or honestly unconfirmed.
Second phone/new guest clears working context in same thread and stale previous sender cannot regain control.

root_live_preflight.schema_correction: AssignmentPage uses assignments, not items. Initial count was corrected; existing assignment preserved.
root_live_preflight.observed_shape: received; imessage; human sender; agent receiver; direct two-participant space; projectId/createdAt present
